searchText: Looks like Eth Docker and Siren are the only tooling that uses this endpoint at present (see https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues/4635#issuecomment-1713870143), and the version siren uses (lighthouse) isn't spec compliant anyway. So it sounds like we might be able to introduce this breaking change and fix it cleanly before a keymanager spec release? <@884836500037066862> have you got voluntary exit api in keymanager implmeneted? yeah it's there thoughts on it being changed to `GET`? and probably worth asking <@144468805697929216> anyone have thoughts on who's using it? maybe dappnode is jimmys post above, maybe dappnode, i'd be tempted to deprecate and declare a new one Haven't looked at the keymanger API so no thoughts either way. prysm is returning the correct format in any case 🤔 we return ``` {"data":{"message":{"epoch":"196868","validator_index":"505597"},"signature":"0xhexsig"}} ``` the prysm ui has been frozen so it doesn't take advantage of this lido operators may take advantage of this maybe? not sure, i've reached out to the dappnode ppls lets just assume someone uses it i think, and deprecate the POST. it's too hard to know and it's been there a while... happy with that <@876848471129333820> ? it's going to be a lot less dispruptive i think, someone is sure to be using it i think this whole thought process is why i decided to just leave it as a POST And move on when we implemented it

excerpts.author: jimmygchen
excerpts.content: Looks like Eth Docker and Siren are the only tooling that uses this endpoint at present (see https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues/4635#issuecomment-1713870143), and the version siren uses (lighthouse) isn't spec compliant anyway. So it sounds like we might be able to introduce this breaking change and fix it cleanly before a keymanager spec release?
